notes.title: Holiday Hotfix 2023
notes.notes:
I've managed to locate the old files and implemented a fix for the tutorial soft locking that was preventing new players from hopping into a fresh dungeon.

As a result of years of engine updates, the file structure is also a bit different so the update will change a bit more than just the quick fix, but my tests have everything running fine over here. This may reset options settings for veteran players, but should not reset progress.

Let me know if you have any further issues!

notes.title: The Golf Labs Update
notes.notes:
This update brings the brand new [b]Golf Labs[/b] to Arcane Golf!

The Golf Lab was originally envisioned as a place for us to release periodic, experimental game updates not tied to the traditional dungeon structure (though it didn't quite work out that way, but more on that below).  Today we're adding 50 1-shot levels spread across all 4 dungeons, remixed with different traps, and with some brand new features including:

[list]
[*] Multi-directional wind
[*] Slimes that ride moving platforms
[*] The Anti-Gravity Gem
[/list]
Unfortunately, this may prove to be the only content that makes it into the Golf Labs.  We'd love to add more, and have appreciated the positive response across all platforms (especially to our huge 2.0 re-release), but ultimately we may have to move on to new projects for a variety of reasons.

If this is our last update though, we just want to say thank you to everyone that picked up our weird little indie game, and we hope you enjoy this last bit of new content.  But hey, never say never.

notes.title: The Accessibility Update (v.2.2)
notes.notes:
3 years ago we released Arcane Golf on PC.  Last year we took all of the feedback around the internet and rebuilt the game to be better in the free update, Arcane Golf 2.0. [b]This year our new publishing partner, Clickteam, helped us bring our updated vision to mobile platforms[/b], and it's been a great success so far, but we're not stopping!

[b]The first[/b] in what will hopefully be many more content and feature updates of 2021, helps further smooth out difficulty, adds new features to help gamers of all types, brings a new in-game achievement viewer, and lets you skip levels and come back on your own terms.

[h2]Full Patch Notes:[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]New Feature:[/b] Level Skip!  Players can now skip any level after trying it once.  Feeling stuck?  Move on and come back to it on your own time.
[*][b]New Feature:[/b] Achievement Viewer:  You can now select the trophy from the main menu to view all of the possible achievements and see which you've unlocked already.  This includes the hidden achievements.
[*][b]New Feature:[/b] Easy Reading Mode:  A new toggle to the options menu will allow you to reduce tutorial length, and double the text size on screen
[*][b]New Feature:[/b] Visual Assist Mode:  A new toggle to the options menu will allow you to disable all unnecessary background art and add a brighter highlight around the ball itself.
[*][b]New Content:[/b] In addition to the visual assist, we've added a couple more ball colors in the options menu to give you greater flexibility (and choice) with what your game looks like.  The new bright white ball can further help you stay focused on the action.
[*][b]Quality of Life:[/b] Additional text has been added to Dank Dungeon Tutorial on level 5.  Some players still think they need to click directly on the ball to aim and shoot, and this should act as a gentle reminder if they don't read the first tutorial...unless they don't read this either.
[*][b]Quality of Life:[/b] A number of levels have had their layouts tweaked, most notably Forest Ruins Levels 34 and 37.  If you have feedback on other problematic levels that don't feel fun or fair, let us know in the comments!
[*][b]Pricing:[/b] We've updated our PC pricing to more closely match the mobile game.  The PC version has additional quality of life features and flexibility and is our primary development platform, but we think $2.99 is an amazing price for 200 levels of physics goodness!
[/list]

notes.title: Quality of Life Update #003
notes.notes:
In today's update we have some fun additions and fixes, as well as a brand new play option that will help casual fans enjoy more of the game.  So let's get to it!

[list]
    [*]This is the big one:  We've added a "Casual Aim Mode" option to the options menu.  If you enable this there will no longer be any shot timer.  We heard from a handful of our players that they would like an option with less pressure and more time to aim.  We've always wanted Arcane Golf to appeal to a wide range of player skill levels, so we hope this helps.  This may make some levels too easy, but overall it should provide a much more relaxing experience for those of you that want it.

There is new text on levels 3 and 5 of the Dank Dungeon that will tell new players about this option if they miss it.

    [*]New "Ball Color" option in the options menu.  It just wouldn't be mini golf without the ability to choose what color your ball was.  Of course it also wouldn't be mini golf if nobody got upset that they didn't get their favorite color.  We consider this a feature ;)  More colors may be added in the future.

    [*]Also, as promised we've added the ability to rebind a "quick restart" key.  In our last update we added the option for players to quickly restart a level by pressing the "R" key.  Now you can set it to whatever key you want!

    [*]Lastly, we made a small fix to the tutorial system.  Quick restarting a level, then exiting and replaying that level could cause the text to get jumbled.  This should no longer happen, but let us know!
[/list]

That concludes our latest quality of life update.  As always, we want to hear how we can improve your experience with our game, so be sure to follow us on twitter (the best place to connect with us) [url=https://twitter.com/Gold5Games] @Gold5Games[/url]

notes.title: Quality of Life Update #002
notes.notes:
It's time for another small update.  We've continued to get some great feedback from our growing community of players and we wanted to get in some quick changes based on that to help foster the best possible experience.

[list]
    [*]First up, we added a quck restart key.  Players can now press "R" to quickly restart a level instead of clicking any buttons.  In the next update this will be noted in the options menu, and will be rebindable to any key you would like.

    [*]Level 47 of the Dank Dungeon has been adjusted to be a bit easier.  It's one of our favorite levels, but based on feedback, we realize it may have been too difficult that early in the game.

    [*]The "Stretch to fit" resolution option has been adjusted.  It was cutting off elements of the game area on certain resolutions, but will now attempt to make the biggest possible playing area without cutting any elements off.

As noted in the options menu, this can result in distortion, so if you want pixel perfect visuals, please choose one of the 1x, 2x, or 3x options from the drop down menu.

    [*]Finally, we added a small line of text to the first tutorial explaining that players can click anywhere to shoot.  It was unclear to some players that they did not have to click on the ball to shoot, and we want to make that as clear as possible.  Avoid the edges of the screen for the best results.
[/list]

notes.title: Quality of Life Update #001
notes.notes:
It's time for our first quality of life update!  

We've appreciated all the kind words and messages we have received through Steam, Twitter, Facebook, email, and elsewhere. We've taken some of that feedback and fixed a few things to improve your gameplay experiences!

[list]
    [*]Slime traps were not quick restarting the level like other hazards.  We have changed this to help smooth things out and make restarting a level easier.

    [*]Pressing Esc. when the pause menu is open will now save any updated sound/music options.  Previously you had to click one of the options menu buttons to resume, restart or quit the level for a save to happen.

    [*]When in windowed mode, the window will no longer re-position to the center of your screen after every restart or new level.  The window will still do this in the options menu to make adjusting resolution easier.

    [*]On rare occasions the game was allowing players to skip levels they had not completed.  This would break the "play next" button that would show up at the end of the level, forcing players back to the level select screen to choose the next level.  This could be fixed by making sure to go back and complete any unfinished levels.  We've put in some protections to hopefully prevent this from happening to anyone else, but it has been a hard bug to replicate.  Let us know if this continues to happen.
[/list]
